terra.problem: The fancy stationery comparison does not connect clearly to preaching good news to the poor.
The passage says the brokenhearted will be bound up; it does not say they will be held.
Papa comments on his own telling with 'I’m just telling it the way it’s written.'
'Mourners need comfort first' adds a priority the passage does not state.
The explanation is flat: it defines ashes and a crown without adding a meaningful insight or a laugh.
'Mourners one day, oaks the next' adds a timeline the passage does not give.
'An oak isn’t bending over for anybody' is not a reliable fact about oaks and suggests a quality the passage does not give the mourners.
'A new title' implies they did not already have it. The passage does not say that.
'Nobody gets a heavier load in this deal' adds a guarantee the passage does not make.
The passage does not say that the covenant in verse 8 extends to the descendants in verse 9.
The passage does not mention people watching from a distance.
The explanation calls the speaker 'him' and 'he,' but the passage does not identify the speaker’s gender.
